section1.title: 1. General Terms
section1.intro: By accessing and using Unifind.Online (the Platform), you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions, which govern your use of our services. These Terms and Conditions apply to all users, including students, specialists, and third-party service providers.
section1.bullet1: Provide accurate and complete information when registering on the Platform.
section1.bullet2: Not misuse the Platform or its services for illegal activities, spamming, or disruptive actions.
section1.bullet3: Comply with applicable laws and regulations in Lebanon and the Middle East.

sub1.title: 1.1 Use of Platform
sub1.bullet1: Provide accurate and complete information when registering on the Platform.
sub1.bullet2: Not misuse the Platform or its services for illegal activities, spamming, or disruptive actions.
sub1.bullet3: Comply with applicable laws and regulations in Lebanon and the Middle East.

sub2.title: 1.2 Liability and Disclaimers
sub2.bullet1: The Platform aggregates information directly from university websites and other official sources. While we strive to provide accurate and up-to-date data, Unifind.Online is not responsible for any discrepancies or inaccuracies.
sub2.bullet2: We are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the Platform or services.
sub2.bullet3: Unifind.Online is not responsible for the actions or outcomes of any third-party services provided through the Platform, including but not limited to training, mentorship, or job application services.

sub3.title: 1.3 Changes to Terms
sub3.text: Unifind.Online reserves the right to update or modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. We will notify users of material changes via email or platform notifications. Continued use of the Platform signifies acceptance of any updated Terms and Conditions.

sub1.title: 2.1 Information Collection
sub1.text: Unifind.Online collects the following personal information:
sub1.item2: User preferences and session data (such as session logs, and usage statistics).
sub1.item3: Payment and billing information for transactions conducted on the Platform.
sub1.item4: Information about services requested, such as consultations, training, or mentorship.
sub1.item5: Data provided when completing forms on the site, including registration forms and mentorship requests.
sub1.item6: Information provided during survey participation, reviews, testimonials, or feedback submission.

sub2.title: 2.2 Use of Information
sub2.item1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services.
sub2.item3: Communicate with users about their bookings, services, and updates.
sub2.item4: Enhance user experience through personalized recommendations.
sub2.item5: Sending newsletters via email, with the option to unsubscribe at any time.

sub3.title: 2.3 Data Sharing and Third-Party Access
sub3.text: We do not sell or rent personal data to third parties. However, we may share information with third-party service providers for payment processing, technical support, and other operational needs. All third parties are required to comply with applicable privacy laws.

sub4.title: 2.4 Data Protection
sub4.text: Unifind.Online takes reasonable security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption, secure storage, and access controls. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is entirely secure.

sub5.title: 2.5 User Rights
sub5.text: Users have the right to access, update, and delete their personal information at any time. If you wish to exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@unifind.online.

sub1.title: 3.1 Service Delivery
sub1.text: Unifind.Online offers a variety of online services designed to enhance the educational and professional experiences of our users. We strive to ensure the timely and efficient delivery of these services, prioritizing user satisfaction in every aspect of the service process.

sub2.title: 3.2 Customer Satisfaction
sub2.bullet1: Quality Assurance: We are committed to delivering high-quality services that meet or exceed your expectations. Our team works diligently to ensure that the services are delivered effectively and efficiently.
sub2.bullet2: Feedback and Support: We encourage open communication and feedback from our users throughout the engagement. Should you have any questions, concerns, or require support regarding the delivery of our services, please contact us at info@unifind.online.
sub2.bullet3: Satisfaction Guarantee: We strive to ensure your satisfaction with our services. If you are unsatisfied with any aspect of the delivery or quality of the services, please contact us immediately. We will make every effort to resolve any issues promptly and provide the best experience possible.

sub3.title: 3.3 Timeliness and Availability
sub3.text: Unifind.Online will make reasonable efforts to ensure that all services are delivered as per the agreed timelines. However, services are subject to availability, and we reserve the right to modify schedules if necessary.

sub4.title: 3.4 User Responsibilities
sub4.text: Users are responsible for ensuring their availability and preparedness for scheduled services, including attending sessions and consultations. If any issues arise regarding the service delivery, users should contact Unifind.Online's customer support team promptly.

subsub1.title: 4.1.1 Live / In-Person Sessions and Workshops
subsub1.text: Live sessions require substantial advance preparation (venues, logistics, coordination) and are subject to the following policy:
subsub1.bullet1: Cancellations made 20 days or more before the scheduled service: Eligible for a full refund via the original payment method, subject to payment provider timelines.
subsub1.bullet2: Cancellations made between 7 and 19 days before the scheduled service: Eligible for a partial refund equivalent to 80% of the amount paid, provided as credit balance on the user's Unifind.Online account. This credit is valid for 6 months.
subsub1.bullet3: Cancellations made less than 7 days before the scheduled service: No refund or credit will be issued.

subsub2.title: 4.1.2 Online Sessions and Workshops (1-on-1 or Group)
subsub2.text: Online sessions require less logistical preparation and therefore allow more flexible cancellation:
subsub2.bullet1: Cancellations made 7 days or more before the scheduled service: Eligible for a full refund via the original payment method, subject to payment provider timelines.
subsub2.bullet2: Cancellations made between 3 and 6 days before the scheduled service: Eligible for a partial refund equivalent to 80% of the amount paid, provided as credit balance on the user's Unifind.Online account. This credit is valid for 6 months.
subsub2.bullet3: Cancellations made less than 3 days before the scheduled service: No refund or credit will be issued.

subsub3.title: 4.1.3 No-Show Policy (Both Live and Online)
subsub3.text: If a user fails to attend a scheduled service without prior cancellation ('no-show'), the booking is forfeited, and no refund or credit will be provided.

subsub4.title: 4.1.4 Post-Service Refund
subsub4.text: No refunds or credits will be issued after a service has been delivered. Unifind.Online is committed to delivering services that meet and exceed user expectations. We continuously strive to ensure the highest standards of quality and user satisfaction in every session and workshop provided.

subsub5.title: 4.1.5 Cancellation by Unifind.Online
subsub5.text: If Unifind.Online cancels a scheduled service (e.g., provider unavailability, force majeure, insufficient enrollment), users will receive a full refund via the original payment method or the option to reschedule at no additional cost.

sub2.title: 4.2 How to Cancel a Service
sub2.text: All cancellation requests must be submitted exclusively via email to info@unifind.online. The email must clearly state: User's full name, Service booked, Scheduled date of the service. The applicable refund or credit will be determined based on the date and time the cancellation email is received.

sub3.title: 4.3 Refund and Credit Process
sub3.text: Full refunds (when applicable) will be processed within 7–10 business days of cancellation confirmation. Processing time depends on banking and payment provider timelines. Credits for partial refunds will be added to the user's Unifind.Online account within 5 business days of cancellation confirmation. Credits are valid for 6 months and may be used for any eligible service on Unifind.Online. After this period, credits will automatically expire and cannot be reinstated. Credits cannot be converted to cash.

sub4.title: 4.4 Exceptional Circumstances
sub4.text: Unifind.Online generally does not accept exceptions to this policy for illness, emergencies, or other personal circumstances. However, in rare and justified cases (e.g., force majeure, serious medical conditions), Unifind.Online may review requests on a discretionary basis.

sub5.title: 4.5 Disputes and Issues
sub5.text: Disputes concerning cancellations or refunds must be submitted in writing to info@unifind.online. All disputes will be reviewed and resolved in accordance with Lebanese consumer protection laws.

sub1.title: 5.1 Advertising on the Platform
sub1.text: Unifind.Online may display advertisements on the Platform, including banner ads, sponsored content, and promotional material. These advertisements may be shown to users based on their activity, preferences, and interests. Advertisements may be sold directly or through third-party advertising networks.

sub2.title: 5.2 Advertiser Content
sub2.bullet1: Endorsements and Sponsorships: Any content provided by advertisers, sponsors, or third parties on the Platform does not necessarily reflect the views, opinions, or recommendations of Unifind.Online. Advertisements and sponsored content are clearly marked to distinguish them from regular platform content.
sub2.bullet2: User Discretion: Users are encouraged to use discretion when interacting with advertisements. Unifind.Online is not responsible for the accuracy, quality, or legality of the products or services advertised by third parties.

sub3.title: 5.3 Ad Placement and User Data
sub3.text: Targeted Advertising: We may use your user data to deliver more relevant advertisements based on your activity on the Platform. By using the Platform, you consent to the use of your data for this purpose, as described in our Privacy Policy. Opting Out: If you prefer not to receive personalized advertisements, you may adjust your preferences in your account settings or follow the instructions provided by our advertising partners.

sub4.title: 5.4 Limitation of Liability for Advertisements
sub4.text: Unifind.Online does not assume any liability or responsibility for the claims, offers, or content made by advertisers. We do not endorse or guarantee the quality, safety, or legality of any goods, services, or offers advertised on the Platform. Users engage with advertisements at their own risk.

sub5.title: 5.5 Advertiser Responsibility
sub5.text: Advertisers are solely responsible for the content they submit to Unifind.Online for display on the Platform. All advertisements must comply with applicable laws, including those relating to intellectual property, consumer protection, and privacy. Unifind.Online reserves the right to reject or remove any advertisement that violates these terms or is deemed inappropriate for display on the Platform.

conclusion.text: These terms and policies are designed to protect both the users and Unifind.Online, ensuring transparency, fairness, and legal compliance. We are committed to providing the best possible experience for our users and will strive to resolve any issues promptly to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. Please review these documents carefully before using the platform's services. If you have any questions or require clarification, please contact our support team at info@unifind.online.

aboutUsParagraph1: Unifind started as a solution for students, by students. We know the struggle of choosing the right path. Today, we have evolved into a comprehensive ecosystem where futures begin. We are not just about academic guidance; we are a bridge for anyone looking to study in Lebanon, offering professional mentorship through our Growth Center and connecting parents, high school students, professionals, and university staff.
aboutUsParagraph2: Our vision is to become the go-to platform for education and career growth, similar to global leaders like StudyPortals and TopUniversities, but with a unique focus on mentorship akin to MentorCruise. We aim to attract international students to Lebanon and empower our local community with the tools they need to succeed.
aboutUsWhyUsHeading2: “Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.”
aboutUsWhyUsParagraph: We are more than a directory. We are a partner in your journey. Whether you are a parent guiding your child, a professional seeking to upskill, or a university looking to attract talent, Unifind is your destination. Our platform integrates academic exploration with real-world mentorship, ensuring that every step you take is a step towards a brighter future.
aboutUsWhyUsDescription: At our company, your success is not just a goal; it is our top priority. We are dedicated to providing you with the tools, resources, and support you need to achieve your aspirations. Our team is committed to understanding your unique challenges and working alongside you to ensure that you reach your full potential.
aboutUsWhyUsCardDescription: Combines academic, career, mentorship, and institutional insights to support students and institutions.
aboutUsWhyUsCardDescription2: Connects students to professionals for practice advice and career paths.
aboutUsWhyUsCardDescription3: Equips students with practical tools and expert with labor market needs.
aboutUsWhyUsCardDescription4: Lebanon’s only free centralized platform for all majors and universities.
